geeklist.title: Denver, CO Virtual Flea Market
geeklist.description:
I've created this geeklist to serve as a no-ship trade and sale marketplace for those of us in the nearby Denver area. The inspiration comes from the Phoenix, AZ, Virtual Flea Market, Seattle, WA Virtual Flea Market, Washington, DC Virtual Flea Market which were inspired by the Portland Virtual Flea Market(and I've taken and modified the header from there - so go there and leave a gg tip if you can).
Of course, folks who aren't local to Denver, and the outlying area should feel free to make offers. You might even convince folks here in town to bundle stuff with other sellers to save on shipping.
Here is the deal for sellers:
1) Anyone relatively close to the Greater Denver Area should feel free to add to the list.
2) Please list one game per geeklist item, as that should help ding people's subscriptions. It's also okay to list a local geeklist auction.
3) Please include all pertinent info including price, condition, edition, location if it isn't on your flag (city and state), and (if available) a link to the BGG Marketplace listing. Feel free to add any other notes, trade desires, photos. Links can be embedded with [ geekurl=<url>]<text>[/geekurl] where <url> does not include the boardgamegeek.com site, so like [ geekurl=/geekmarket/product/798558]Link[/geekurl]
4) Please delete the item in this list when the item is sold/traded.
5) I really dislike to delete items, but I have been asked to keep things fresh, so I will delete years old listings. They can be relisted if there's a significant incentivizing change to the item (like price drop or addition of sweeteners)
6) Please list board and card games only, as a general rule.
7) Please limit the number of games you list at one time to 10. If you have more than that to sell, pick your best 10, and feel free to say that you have more available.
If you have any suggestions or comments or GM me.
P.S. Unless anyone sees anything different, let's just keep this as a permanent list. Please make sure to delete any dead items.
